summary: Comprehensive testing of Optowire Angular SSR product catalog. All core features working: homepage, hero slider (fallback), categories from API, dark/light mode, EN/Chinese language toggle, catalog with sidebar filters, mobile hamburger menu, footer, category card navigation, backend proxy APIs, and ld+json structured data.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') - should use lifespan context manager instead (FastAPI 0.95+)
No data-testid attributes on Angular components (not blocking but reduces testability)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Angular 21 Universal SSR app. Partner key not set so products return 0 results (expected). Categories load from real API (/api/proxy/web/category returns real data). All proxy endpoints return 200. Dark/light mode uses 'dark' class on documentElement. Language toggle shows 中文/EN. Mobile hamburger opens full overlay menu. Category cards navigate to /catalog/category/{id}. ld+json structured data present in SSR HTML.

test_details.homepage: PASS - Hero slider with fallback images, categories from API (Security Systems, Electronic devices, IoT, Tools, Telecommunication, Network Equipments), bilingual labels
test_details.dark_light_mode: PASS - Moon/sun icon in header toggles dark class on html element
test_details.language_toggle: PASS - 中文/EN button switches all UI text to Chinese/English
test_details.catalog_page: PASS - Sidebar filters with real category names, search input, In Stock filter, 0 products shown (expected - no partner key)
test_details.mobile_responsive: PASS - Hamburger menu opens full overlay with nav links and search
test_details.footer: PASS - Company info, category links, page links all present
test_details.ssr: PASS - curl shows rendered app-home, app-header components in page source
test_details.ld_json: PASS - Organization schema present in page source
